question.worked_solution:
First, we isolate the fractional term $-\frac{8x}{5}$ by subtracting $3$ from both sides:

$$
\begin{aligned}-\frac{8x}{5}+3 & =5 \\ -\frac{8x}{5}+3-3 & =5-3 \\ -\frac{8x}{5} & =2\end{aligned}
$$

The fractional coefficient is $-\frac{8}{5},$ so we multiply by its reciprocal ${(-\frac{8}{5})}^{-1}=-\frac{5}{8}.$ This gives:

$$
\begin{aligned}-\frac{5}{8}\cdot (-\frac{8x}{5}) & =-\frac{5}{8}\cdot 2 \\ 1x & =-\frac{10}{8} \\ x & =-\frac{5}{4}\end{aligned}
$$
